rows.en:
As part of training, hold a mock battle
against Destroids inside the Macross.

The giant battleship that fell from space brought humanity new knowledge and technology, and great upheaval, starting with the Unification Wars. Restored as the U.N. Forces battleship "Macross", it now carries OverTechnology's "Valkyrie" variable fighters. A mock battle aboard will double as a test run.

rows.notes: tm kept (stock objective).
tm kept; episode title.

rows.en:
Annihilate the giant aliens striking back
against the Macross's attack.

The Macross's restoration was finally complete, and its launch ceremony held. During it, an unknown space fleet was detected approaching, but the Macross's main cannon fired on the fleet by itself. The Macross had been an alien booby trap set for their enemies. And so, like it or not, war with the aliens began.

rows.notes: Episode title.

rows.en:
Annihilate the giant aliens' ground forces
attacking the Macross. (No large units)
rows.notes: (No large units) = large-frame units cannot sortie; same rendering in every row of this slice.

rows.en: The Macross is under fierce attack from the giant aliens. To break the deadlock, it attempts to launch into space. But the enemy has also sent in ground forces, and launch preparations are getting nowhere. The giant aliens' ground forces must be driven back so the Macross can launch.
rows.notes: Who must repel the ground forces is unstated (passive kept).
Episode title.

rows.en:
To ensure the Macross's fold succeeds,
annihilate the giant aliens interfering.

The Macross escaped to space for now, but the giant aliens kept up the attack, and the space carriers ARMD-1 and ARMD-2 were destroyed just before joining it. To break this desperate situation, Capt. Global decides to fake a descent to Earth and fold to the Moon's far side instead.
rows.notes: ARMD-1/ARMD-2 follow the JP numbering (glossary: ARMD-class space carrier).
tm kept; episode title.

rows.en:
Annihilate the enemy within the time limit
and clear the Macross main cannon's line of fire.

The fold succeeded, but the Macross emerged in Pluto's orbit, and the fold system vanished as well. Another fold is now impossible, and on top of that, even the main cannon is unusable. Still, the alien fleet keeps up its relentless pursuit. The only way to drive it off is to risk a transformation and fire the main cannon.

rows.notes: tm kept.
tm kept.
tm kept (condition label).
Open mission title; katakana-English kept as natural English.

rows.en:
As the volunteers' final test, hold a
mock battle. (No large units)

The enemy was barely driven off, but with the fold system gone, the Macross must return to Earth by conventional travel. With continued battles against the giant aliens judged unavoidable on the long voyage, volunteers were sought among its citizens. A mock battle will train them and gauge their skill.
rows.notes: Who judged / called for volunteers is unstated (passive kept).
tm was 'Defeat Ace Fast'; restored 'Enemy' (JP has it) to match u0277 'Defeat Enemy Ace'.
tm kept; episode title.

rows.en:
To set up the Daedalus Attack, act as a
decoy and draw the giant aliens' attention.

The Macross had only been on the defensive, but Capt. Global decides on a surprise attack near Saturn to wipe out the enemy fleet with a main cannon salvo. But the cannon fails to fire, perhaps from poor upkeep, putting the ship in danger instead. To escape, Lt. Hayase's "Daedalus Attack" plan must succeed at all costs.

rows.notes: tm kept; episode title.

rows.en:
To get supplies, bring the
containers to the designated point.

After repeated battles, the Macross is in need of supplies. Sara Base on Mars has already been abandoned, but the Macross heads for Mars in search of the supplies that are likely still there. Enemy pursuit is expected, but without supplies, even getting back to Earth is in doubt.

rows.notes: tm kept.
Episode title.

rows.en:
Shoot down Quamzin's unit, which has
launched a surprise attack on the Macross.

After battles with the giant aliens and a long voyage, the Macross has finally come within a step of Earth. But the giant aliens' powerful jamming has let an enemy warship close in on the Macross. To reach Earth safely, it must shake off the enemy pursuit at all costs.

rows.notes: tm kept; episode title.

rows.en:
Defend the Cat's Eye until the recon
of the giant aliens is complete.

With Earth in sight but unable to shake its pursuers, the Macross asks U.N. Forces HQ for backup, but HQ orders it to wear the enemy down as much as it can -- in effect, to buy time. Then a strange message comes: the enemy demands surrender! Lt. Hayase takes off in the Cat's Eye recon plane to learn its real aim.

rows.notes: Episode title.

rows.en:
Infiltrate the enemy ship to rescue
the recon team. (No large units)

The Cat's Eye recon plane carrying Lt. Hayase was captured by the enemy, and contact is lost with 2nd Lt. Ichijyo and the other Valkyries sent to save her. Their survival is unconfirmed, but they can't be left to die, and a rescue should also yield valuable intel. A plan to infiltrate the enemy ship and rescue them is drawn up.

rows.notes: tm kept.
tm kept; episode title.

rows.en: The enemy ship the team infiltrated folded far from the Macross, but Lt. Hayase's group was rescued. They say the aliens, who call themselves Zentradi, know only war and chase the Macross out of interest in and fear of human culture. Now an enemy ship that seems set to launch for the Macross has been found.

rows.notes: tm kept; episode title.

rows.en:
To break the encirclement and reach Earth,
annihilate the Zentradi forces.

The enemy ship that folded out was indeed headed for the Macross. The rescue team escaped it and came back safely with Lt. Hayase's group. Their shocking report told of an enemy of unimaginable size and strange nature, and a hopeless gap in strength. Still, Capt. Global resolves to break the siege and return to Earth.

rows.notes: tm kept; episode title.

rows.en:
Defeat Quamzin's forces, which have
attacked the Macross.

Back on Earth after a year, the Macross still has no landing permit from U.N. Forces HQ. With the ground right there yet unable to leave the ship, the citizens grow ever more discontent. Meanwhile, Quamzin, chafing at orders against rash moves on the Macross, defies them and attacks it.

rows.notes: Condition label.
tm kept; episode title.

rows.en:
To keep the enemy from nearing the Macross,
drive them back. (No large units)

As the Macross takes on supplies at sea, a Zentradi warship rapidly closes in. It is Milia's unit; she has heard from Quamzin that "the Macross has a crack pilot too." Busy resupplying, the Macross cannot move. The enemy must be driven back so the resupply can finish safely.
rows.notes: Milia is female (glossary); 'unit' here = her squad. Who must drive the enemy back is unstated (passive kept).
tm kept; episode title.

rows.en:
To let the civilians land, annihilate the
Zentradi forces. (No large units)

Seeking a place for its civilians, the Macross is granted permission by the Ontario Autonomous Zone to take them in. The ship rejoices at the news, but the Zentradi forces appear as if to stop it. Annihilate the Zentradi forces at all costs so the civilians can be taken in.

rows.notes: Episode title.

rows.en:
So the Daedalus Attack isn't disrupted,
annihilate the enemy. (No large units)

U.N. Forces Supreme HQ concluded that the Zentradi's target was the Macross, not Earth, and launched the Macross back into space. Attacked by numerous Zentradi fleets, the Macross tries to escape the crisis by destroying enemy ships one by one with the Daedalus Attack.

rows.notes: tm kept; episode title.

rows.en:
Annihilate the Zentradi forces
launching an all-out attack.

With the Daedalus Attack turned against it, the Macross was invaded by many enemy units, but some of them wanted to defect. To the Zentradi, who knew only war, Earth culture was an immeasurable culture shock. Alarmed, Boddole Zer, commander of the Zentradi main fleet, launched an all-out attack on the Macross.

rows.notes: tm kept.
tm kept; episode title.

rows.en:
To push on to Boddole Zer's flagship,
annihilate the Zentradi forces.

With many defecting, Vrlitwhai chose a ceasefire and sent archivist Exsedol to the Macross. He says main fleet commander Boddole Zer will likely erase the Macross and Vrlitwhai's Culture-tainted men alike. To beat such hopeless odds, song must deliver a culture shock, and the flagship must be hit in the chaos.
rows.notes: 'archivist' for kiroku sanbou (record-keeping staff officer, Exsedol's post); 'his men' for Vrlitwhai-tachi.
tm kept; film title.

rows.en:
To end the interstellar war, defeat main
fleet commander Boddole Zer. (No large units)

Minmay's song dealt the Zentradi forces a culture shock, throwing their chain of command into confusion, if only for a while. This confusion must be used to defeat Boddole Zer, commander of the Zentradi main fleet, and end the war with the Zentradi.
rows.notes: Who must exploit the confusion is unstated (passive kept).
Open mission title; katakana-English kept as natural English.

rows.en:
Win the hand-to-hand combat training.
(No large units)

For the warrior-race Zentradi, daily combat drills are vital. Hand-to-hand combat without mobile weapons, above all, is both the basis of fighting and the last resort. Winning hand-to-hand drills is also a mark of status for a Zentradi.

rows.notes: Open mission title; katakana-English kept as natural English.

rows.en: The Micronian battleship we're chasing seems about to stop at the red planet. Our advance party found an unmanned base there; the enemy likely plans to resupply. If we exploit an opening to destroy the supplies, the ship should be easy to take.
rows.notes: Zentradi-side briefing: subject restored as 'we' (Zentradi forces).
tm kept.

rows.en:
To capture a Micronian sample,
launch a diversionary attack.

The recon team sent to investigate near the Micronian battleship has returned, but could not bring back any concrete records. Even their direct reports were full of baffling content, and no useful intel was gained. To advance the investigation, we will launch a diversionary attack and capture Micronians to serve as samples.
rows.notes: Zentradi-side briefing: subject restored as 'we'.
tm kept.
Title: 'Vermillion' spelled as glossary Vermillion Flight; sukoodoron rendered 'Squadron'.

rows.en:
Destroy the Micronian mobile weapons that
have broken into our ship. (No large units)

The diversion succeeded, and we captured Micronian samples. However, several enemy mobile weapons have broken into our ship, apparently to rescue the captured samples. We need no more samples, so destroy them swiftly.

To get a spy aboard the enemy ship,
approach it in secret.

Information from the captured samples suggests the Micronians we contacted may be the legendary Protoculture. To investigate further, a micronized spy will be infiltrated into the enemy ship. Approach the enemy ship under cover of battle and send the spy in.

rows.notes: Title is a katakana pun (desutoroi desutoroido); rendered 'Destroy the Destroids'.

rows.en: The Micronian battleship seems to have reached the enemy's home planet. We were ordered not to attack the Micronians rashly, as they may be the legendary Protoculture, but to watch them for now. Yet the Quamzin clan has apparently defied orders and struck the enemy ship. We can't let Quamzin's crew beat us to it.
rows.notes: Kamujin ikka -> 'the Quamzin clan'; Kamujin-tachi -> 'Quamzin's crew'.

rows.en:
Infiltrate the enemy ship and annihilate the enemy.
(No large units)

Intercepted combat footage and the enemy ship's sudden high-output energy attack leave no doubt: the enemy we face is the Protoculture. We must capture that ship and gain the Protoculture's power at all costs. The best plan is to exploit the enemy's direct attack and seize the ship from within.
rows.notes: 'the enemy's direct attack' kept literal; presumably the Macross ramming the Zentradi ship (Daedalus-style), which the Zentradi plan to use to board it.
Katakana title 'Riboruto Bodoruzaa' rendered 'Revolt Against Boddole Zer'.

rows.en:
Break through the Boddole Zer Main Fleet with the
Macross and storm the flagship. (No large units)

As our troops defect one after another to the power of Culture, Commander Vrlitwhai has chosen a ceasefire with the Macross. But Boddole Zer sees Culture only as a threat and will try to destroy the Macross and us alike. To save Culture and Minmay's song, we must join the Macross in repelling the Boddole Zer Main Fleet.

As part of training, hold a
mock battle against Destroids.

To prepare for emergencies like Zentradi remnant revolts or unknown threats, the New U.N. Forces were pressed to keep their arms up to date. The current mainstay, the VF-11, has served nearly 10 years, and a successor is rumored to be in development. But whatever the machine, the pilot's skill is what counts, of course.

Suppress the Zentradi remnants
rioting on a frontier planet.

Zentradi remnants have reportedly rioted on a frontier planet outside the solar system. They have no intention of accepting our call to surrender, so combat is unavoidable. Orders have come down to annihilate the Zentradi remnants.

To gauge your aptitude as a test pilot,
hold a mock battle under live-combat rules.
rows.notes: JP writes tekisei with the 'correct' kanji (typo for aptitude); read as aptitude. Player addressed as 'you'.

rows.en: The rumored next-generation mainstay variable fighter was being developed on planet Eden as "Project Super Nova". It is a competition between two companies, but reportedly neither prototype can be handled properly by an average pilot. Test pilot candidates will fly a mock battle under live-combat rules.

Pass through each target area in turn,
as quickly as possible.

To measure the prototype's flight performance, a test will see how fast it can go over the sea. It also examines airframe performance like thrust and maneuverability, and the G-load on the pilot. The test is a time trial: the time taken to pass through every target point.
Reach as many points as possible

Destroy targets and run a time trial to the
target area. (No large units)

To measure the prototype's agility, a test will see how well it performs in a confined space like a sheer canyon. The test is scored on the destruction rate of targets along the route and a time trial to the destination.
Destroy targets and reach the target point

rows.notes: Katakana 'infaito' kept as 'Infight Test' (close-range fighting); alternative 'Close Combat Test'.

rows.en:
Destroy the units that keep appearing,
within the time limit.
To measure the prototype's combat ability, a ground battle will test what combat results it can achieve. The goal of the test is to destroy as many units as possible within the time limit.
Destroy as many enemies as possible

Stop the escorted bombers from
reaching their target point.

To gather practical combat data on the prototype, an air combat test will be held. It is a key test of how it performs in air combat, the very heart of a variable fighter. It is a mock battle against aircraft: destroy the bombers escorted by VF-11s before they reach the target area.
For practical combat data on the prototype, a naval test will be held: a mock battle against aircraft and a carrier. Destroy the carrier escorted by VF-11s.

To gather practical combat data on the prototype, a ground combat test will be held. It is one of the key tests of how well the prototype performs under near-real combat conditions. The goal is to destroy a base guarded by VF-11s and Destroids.

rows.notes: Katakana title 'Batoru Eden' kept as 'Battle Eden' (a mock duel on Eden, not a battle for Eden).

rows.en:
Destroy the rival competition machine.
(No large units)

To gather combat data between prototypes, a mock battle will be fought against the rival model. Mock rounds are used, but the opponent has ace-level skill, so stay sharp. Needless to say, this is the most important test for adoption.
rows.notes: 'ki wo nuku koto wa dekinai' (impersonal) rendered as directive 'stay sharp' to the player.

rows.en:
As a live-combat test of the prototype,
annihilate the Zentradi remnants.
Zentradi remnants have been reported on a moon near planet Eden. Since the entire area is snowfield, an unusual condition, annihilating them will double as a live-combat test.
rows.notes: kinrin eisei (nearby satellite) -> 'a moon near planet Eden'.

rows.en:
Annihilate the New U.N. Forces soldiers who
have run amok at the ceremony site.

Unrest has been detected in Macross City on Earth, host of the ceremony for the 30th anniversary of the end of the Space War. New U.N. Forces soldiers have run amok, casting an eerie mood over the ceremony. To end this emergency, the rampaging soldiers will be annihilated.
rows.notes: Uchuu taisen (unnumbered) rendered 'the Space War', not 'Space War I'.

rows.en:
To stop Sharon's rampage, annihilate the enemies
she controls. (No large units)

Sharon Apple, the galaxy's most popular virtual idol, has run amok and seized the New U.N. Forces' central command. Her song has a hypnotic effect, and New U.N. Forces troops are controlled by her singing. To free the people from that devil's song, the enemies Sharon controls must be annihilated.
Hold a mock battle as training.

The Macross 7 fleet seeks a new planet to colonize. In vast space, the danger of meeting unknown aliens, and of that leading to a war like Space War I, is ever present. To be ready for emergencies, combat training can never be neglected.

Annihilate the Zentradi remnants blocking
the Macross 7 fleet's voyage.

Several unidentified craft were spotted on the Macross 7 fleet's planned route. A survey to secure the route revealed them to be Zentradi remnants. What's more, on finding the fleet, they attacked without a word. With no other choice, we will drive off the Zentradi remnants.
Wipe out the unknowns that just appeared.

Battle 7 received word from a forward picket that it is under surprise attack by an unidentified force. The unidentified craft are using bizarre attacks never seen before, and more and more pilots are losing all will and being put out of action. To keep them from nearing the fleet, the unidentified craft must be annihilated.
rows.notes: zen'eitei (advance/vanguard boat) rendered 'forward picket'.

rows.en:
Annihilate the Varauta Army forces in City 7.
(No large units)

The unknown craft that attacked the Macross 7 fleet proved to be modified U.N. Forces units once deployed in the Varauta system, a colony star system. Their reason for attacking is still unknown, but the enemy will be called the Varauta Army. Now the Varauta Army has attacked again and broken into City 7.
rows.notes: Togo-gun (pre-New) rendered 'U.N. Forces' per brief: the Varauta units were old U.N. Forces machines.

rows.en:
Recover the containers holding citizens
while annihilating the Varauta Army.

A string of kidnappings of citizens had been occurring in City 7. The Varauta Army was loading the kidnapped citizens into containers to ship them to Varauta vessels. To rescue the abducted people, we must recover the containers while driving off the Varauta Army.

Annihilate the Varauta Army that has invaded City 7.
(No large units)

Forced to fold by a Varauta Army ploy, City 7 has been cut off from Battle 7 as well. The Varauta Army is steadily pushing into City 7. City 7 has only a handful of forces, but damage to the city must be kept to a minimum.

rows.notes: TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
To test units provided by civilians,
hold a mock battle. (No large units)

To make up for City 7's lack of forces while it still can't rejoin Battle 7, a Battroid Carnival was held to collect weapons owned by citizens. Since the weapons are civilian property, mock battles will be held to test them.
Annihilate all enemies / Protect the target
rows.notes: TM kept.

rows.en:
Save as many civilian units as you can and annihilate
the Varauta Army. (No large units)

To make up for City 7's lack of forces while it still can't rejoin Battle 7, a Battroid Carnival was held to collect weapons owned by citizens. With all kinds of Battroids gathered, the Varauta Army showed up. Protect the citizens' Battroids and annihilate the Varauta Army.

rows.notes: TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
Defeat Gigile within the time limit,
before City 7 crosses the critical point.

City 7 is being dragged toward a blazing star by powerful gravity. In the middle of this emergency the Varauta Army attacks, but City 7 also manages to rejoin Battle 7. To dock City 7 with Battle 7 and make a fold possible, hold off the Varauta Army until the system repairs are done.

rows.notes: TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en: At planet Lux, the Macross 7 fleet learns from its advance scouts that the Macross 5 fleet was attacked by an unknown party. Then a large Varauta force appears at Lux and strikes the fleet hard. The fleet will try to repel it by destroying the Varauta flagship to throw the enemy's command into chaos.

rows.notes: TM kept.
TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
Defeat the Protodeviln Glavil, or survive
until the time limit.

A single Protodeviln is said to have the power to wipe out an entire Zentradi fleet, and they draw that power from Spiritia, the life energy of humans. The Varauta Army attacking the Macross 7 fleet was being controlled by the Protodeviln to gather Spiritia. And now the Protodeviln themselves have appeared before the fleet.

rows.notes: TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
Keep Gigile, here to rescue a comrade, from
reaching the target area. (No large units)
rows.notes: Line cut moved slightly: JP line 1 ends mid-phrase before 'reaching'.

rows.en: Thanks to information from a certain girl, the Macross 7 fleet managed to capture a Protodeviln. It was being studied aboard Battle 7 when a Protodeviln came to take back its comrade and broke into the ship. The captive Protodeviln must not be taken.

rows.notes: Glossary missions (episode).

rows.en: On planet Lux, the Macross 7 fleet found ruins thought to have been left by the Protoculture. Studying them may reveal some way to fight back against the Protodeviln. But in the middle of the survey, Glavil appeared and attacked.

rows.notes: Open title: literally 'ghosts of old'; the mission is about Zentradi remnants.

rows.en:
Annihilate the Zentradi remnants that
attacked in the asteroid field.

To escape Protodeviln attacks, the Macross 7 fleet was traveling hidden in an asteroid field. But Zentradi remnants hiding there too spotted it. Now that the fleet had seen them, the remnants had no intention of letting it go, and attacked us.

rows.notes: Open title.

rows.en:
Repel the Protodeviln that have
found the Macross 7 fleet.

The Macross 7 fleet is worn out by battle after battle. It had been hiding on a planet found along the way to get some rest, but in vain: the Protodeviln found it. Repel the Protodeviln to protect the exhausted Macross 7 fleet.

rows.notes: TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
Annihilate the Protodeviln within the time limit.
(No large units)

U.N. Forces HQ on Earth gives the Macross 7 fleet a special order to annihilate the Protodeviln. In response, the fleet decides to launch Operation Stargazer, a surprise strike by a small elite team on the 4th planet of Varauta 3198XE. Annihilate the Protodeviln so reaction weapons can be fired into them.
rows.notes: Last JP sentence literally: 'to fire reaction weapons into the Protodeviln, annihilate the Protodeviln'.
Glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
Reach the hangar and escape within the time limit.
(No large units)

The do-or-die Operation Stargazer failed, and the team was captured by the Protodeviln. But they managed to slip past the enemy and got a chance to escape. Steal an enemy ship from the hangar before enemy units close in, and make it back to the Macross 7.
rows.notes: JP drops who was captured; 'the team' (the Stargazer strike team) restored.
Glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
Defeat Gamlin, who is being
controlled by the Protodeviln.

The team made it safely back from the enemy's home base to the Macross 7 fleet. But the fight against the Protodeviln is not over. As if to prove it, the Protodeviln take control of soldiers in the fleet. The damage to the fleet must not be allowed to spread any further.
rows.notes: JP drops who returned; 'the team' restored (follows u0392).

rows.en: A Song Echoing Across the Galaxy
rows.notes: TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
To defeat Gepelnitchi and win peace,
annihilate the Protodeviln.
Gepelnitchi, the leader of the Protodeviln so to speak, was about to awaken. To stop his Spiritia Farm Project, the Macross 7 fleet launched another assault on the 4th planet of Varauta 3198XE.
rows.notes: Gepelnitchi is male in the glossary.
TM kept.
Open title; katakana English.

rows.en: Attack the enemy fleet and absorb Spiritia.
rows.notes: Protodeviln-side mission.

rows.en: After a 500,000-year slumber, Gepelnitchi and the other Protodeviln have awoken. They cannot live without absorbing Spiritia, the energy of living beings. And now a fleet packed with beings rich in Spiritia has been found. As the Protodeviln vanguard, you are to gather Spiritia.
rows.notes: Protodeviln-side briefing; the final sentence has no subject in JP, 'you' (the player) restored.
Glossary missions (term).

rows.en:
Destroy enemy units and capture the one
thought to possess Anima Spiritia.
rows.notes: JP 'kotai' = an individual being; 'the one' keeps it neutral.

rows.en: Over several Spiritia-absorption missions, it became clear that one being gives off an abnormal amount of Spiritia. Most likely it bears the "Anima Spiritia" once used to seal the Protodeviln. You have been ordered to capture it to make use of the Anima Spiritia.

rows.notes: TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
To keep them out of the flagship Island 1,
annihilate the unknown life-forms.

While heading for the galactic core, Macross Frontier was suddenly attacked by a swarm of unknown life-forms. Seeing their overwhelming firepower, New U.N. Forces command judged it could not stop this emergency alone and called on the private military provider S.M.S. to deploy.

rows.notes: Glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
Annihilate the unknown life-forms that
got into Island 1. (No large units)

Despite S.M.S.'s efforts, the unknown life-forms broke into Island 1. Several VF-25s are chasing them to defend Island 1's residential area, but many got in. To keep the citizens safe, the enemy must be wiped out at all costs.

rows.notes: Open title; katakana English.

rows.en: Hold a joint mock battle with the New U.N. Forces.

The private military provider S.M.S. deploys at the Frontier Administrative Bureau's request in emergencies the New U.N. Forces can't handle. So it is naturally expected to outfight the regular military. In this joint mock battle with the New U.N. Forces, S.M.S. must show its full strength.

rows.notes: Open title; katakana English.

rows.en: Destroy the Zentradi remnants' secret base.

Even now, 50 years after Space War I, many Zentradi remnants still defy the New U.N. Government. The suspicious facility found on an asteroid near the Macross Frontier's route was one of their secret bases. The unit sent ahead to investigate was shot down without warning. Battle is now unavoidable.
rows.notes: JP says 'the interstellar war'; glossary Space War I used.
TM kept.
Open title; katakana English.

rows.en:
Join a mock battle that also serves to
evaluate the VF-25. (No large units)

The VF-25, deployed early to S.M.S., is a next-gen variable fighter developed to succeed the VF-171. It performs superbly but demands great skill and puts heavy strain on its pilot. A mock battle between VF-25s will be held, doubling as an evaluation for official New U.N. Forces adoption.

rows.notes: Open title; katakana English.

rows.en:
Join a mock battle against Skull Squadron.
(No large units)

The VF-25's high performance is proven, but countering the unknown life-forms that hit the Frontier fleet clearly also takes pilots skilled enough to draw it out. To use the VF-25 effectively, live-combat training will be held with the elite Skull Squadron.

rows.notes: TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en: Annihilate the Vajra that have reappeared.

The unknown life-forms that attacked Macross Frontier have been named the Vajra. Every Vajra in the last attack was thought to have been repelled, but that was a mistake. Vajra survivors were lurking in Island 3. They have resumed activity and begun attacking the Frontier fleet again.

rows.notes: TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
As a member of the test team,
hold a mock battle with the applicants.

The final test for S.M.S. applicants will be held on an old Zentradi battlefield: a mock battle against three Queadluun-Rheas. As a member of the test team, join the applicants in a mock battle against the Pixie Team, led by Captain Klan Klang.

rows.notes: TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
Annihilate the Vajra that attacked
the Galaxy fleet. (No large units)

An emergency fold transmission reports that the giant emigrant fleet Macross Galaxy has come under massive Vajra attack. Galaxy is badly damaged but not wiped out, and its remaining ships seem to still be under attack. S.M.S. has been called out to rescue the survivors and defend the Frontier fleet.

rows.notes: TM kept.
TM kept; glossary missions (episode).

rows.en:
Annihilate the Vajra
that have attacked you.

Checking reports of Vajra encounters turned up a sector very likely to hold a Vajra nest. A unit was sent to survey the nest and, if possible, recover cocoons, but the Vajra spotted it almost at once. The operation now shifts to annihilating the attacking Vajra.

rows.notes: TM kept (MF ep. 12).

rows.en:
To rescue the concert tour crew,
wipe out the Zentradi rebel forces.

Sheryl Nome, the Galactic Fairy, came to the planet Gallia 4 for a morale concert. But Sheryl, who had come despite being ill, collapsed on arrival, and the concert was put on hold. Using that as an excuse, Zentradi resentful of humans rioted, and things escalated until the concert crew were taken hostage.
rows.notes: chikyujin rendered 'humans'.

rows.en: Protect the target / Annihilate all enemies
rows.notes: TM kept.
TM kept (MF ep. 13).

rows.en:
Clear out the Vajra cocoons inside the Global.
(No large units)

The Global, flagship of the 117th Research Fleet, was sunk by the Vajra 11 years ago. Found on the planet Gallia 4, the Global had already become a Vajra nest. To stop the Vajra from breeding, the Vajra cocoons inside the ship must be wiped out.

rows.notes: TM kept.
TM kept (MF ep. 14).

rows.en:
Reach the Vajra ship believed to be commanding
all the Vajra. (No large units)

Macross Frontier was under a Vajra attack like none before. Not only was the swarm bigger than ever, the Vajra were clearly launching an organized attack. The only way left for the fleet to survive is to destroy the giant Vajra ship thought to be issuing the orders and break their chain of command.

rows.notes: TM kept.
Also used in mission script mf_131.
Open title; 'narazumono' = rogue/ruffian. The mission has the player follow the Vajra Queen's orders, so the title may describe the player side.

rows.en: Obey the Queen's orders and defeat the enemy.
Every Vajra acts according to the orders of the Vajra Queen. The Queen has issued the order to attack.

rows.notes: Lone title string between two missions, no objective or briefing of its own; literal 'U.N. Forces' (not New U.N.) + 2059. Purpose unclear (possibly an unused/debug title).
TM kept.

rows.en: Annihilate the Anti-U.N. Forces raiding the U.N. base.

About a year after the Earth-wide Unification Wars ended, the Anti-U.N. Forces attack a U.N. Forces base. They have fielded the SV-51, a variable fighter built with OverTechnology. Keep their units away from the base and wipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces.

rows.notes: Bonus objective; same pattern as u0220 'Defeat Ace Fast'.
Bonus objective; same pattern as u0220 'Defeat Ace Fast'.
TM kept.

rows.en:
Annihilate the Anti-U.N. Forces that came
to steal the ancient alien relic.

Besides the giant battleship that crashed on South Ataria Island, another ancient alien relic of seemingly the same kind has been found. The U.N. Forces were secretly studying it, but the Anti-U.N. Forces learned of it and raided the research carrier to gain new OverTechnology. Don't let them take the relic.
Protect the target / Annihilate all enemies
rows.notes: Same as u0441 (half-width space variant).

rows.en:
Take on legendary squadrons and duos,
and seize victory.
rows.notes: shotai rendered 'squadrons' per glossary note on Skull Squadron.

rows.en: In every era, squadrons and duos bound by unbreakable ties have achieved remarkable feats. By joining forces, these comrades made possible missions that seemed impossible for anyone alone. Stand against these battle-hardened heroes and forge a new legend.

rows.notes: Open title; literal 'battle against warriors' (the opponents are Destroids and enemy units).

rows.en: Defeat Destroids and enemy units from every era.

Variable fighters aren't the only ones fighting on fierce battlefields. Many units fought beside us as allies or fiercely against us as enemies. To know the whole history of war, take on the Destroids and enemy units of every era.

rows.notes: Glossary missions entry (term).

rows.en:
To witness their splendid final moments,
wipe out the endless swarm of grunts.
Not only the strong shine as flowers of the battlefield. The weak, too, have beauty as they fall like petals. To burn their splendid fall into memory, lay waste to the grunts that keep coming.

rows.notes: Open title, literal.

rows.en: Make it out of Macross Hell alive.

The name of the Macross, which ended Space War I, passed on to the emigrant ships roaming the galaxy. Every battleship bearing the Macross name has immense firepower to guard against unknown threats. Learn their power firsthand and make it out of Macross Hell alive.
Defeat the mightiest foes of every era.

Perhaps humanity's history of conflict was sealed the moment it picked up the giant space battleship that fell from the sky. Humanity has been drawn into conflict after conflict: Space War I, the Varauta War, the Vajra invasion. To break this cycle of conflict, crush these mighty foes.
Become No. 1 in Macross Ace Frontier.

There is only one thing to do in this mission: defeat every unit that appears in Macross Ace Frontier and be recognized as a true ace. To settle who is the strongest, put everything on the line and fight.

rows.notes: Glossary missions entry.

rows.en:
Wipe out the rampaging Famitsu editors.
(No large units)

Reports say the Weekly Famitsu editorial staff have taken prototype variable fighters and risen in armed revolt. Why prototypes are swarming in such numbers is unknown, but something feels seriously off. The editors' rampage must be stopped before the city is reduced to rubble.
rows.notes: Japanese title brackets around the magazine name dropped.
Glossary missions entry.

rows.en: Defeat every character from across the series.
Famous characters from the Macross series have joined forces across time! This is a true Super Dimension battle!
rows.notes: chojiku = Super Dimension (series title wording).

rows.en: The Super Dimension Editorial Department Dengeki
rows.notes: Glossary missions entry.

rows.en: Editor-in-Chief Kuranishi, shot down time and again, suddenly vanished, shouting "I'll cross time and space!" Meanwhile, a giant creature appeared on a far-off asteroid and set off for Earth, asteroid and all. At this rate, Earth is in danger!
rows.notes: Kuranishi kept gender-neutral (no pronouns).
Glossary missions entry.

rows.en: Wipe out the Zentradi forces that suddenly appeared.
Earth should be at peace, yet Zentradi weapons have suddenly swarmed in en masse. In strangely neat rows, too. Amid this oddly nostalgic vibe, just take the enemy down!
rows.notes: Neat rows + nostalgia = Space Invaders gag; kept implicit as in the Japanese.

rows.en: Battle Roy Focker and seize victory.

He may love his drink and his women, but he is renowned as the U.N. Forces' top ace: Skull Leader, Roy Focker. A first-class pilot who looks after those under him, he is the very model of a pilot. Fight Focker, the legendary pilot who loved the sky above all else.
rows.notes: kohai = juniors, rendered 'those under him'.
Open title, literal.

rows.en:
Battle Maximilian Jenius
and seize victory.

Maximilian Jenius, the genius pilot who proved his talent by downing 7 enemies in his first battle. Living up to the name, he beat a Zentradi ace in a one-on-one duel and achieved history's first interstellar marriage, something no ordinary person could do. Fight Max, a genius by everyone's account, his own included.

rows.notes: TM kept.

rows.en:
Defeat Hayao Kakizaki, gone wild from hunger.
(No large units)

A big talker with only average piloting skills, yet somehow hard to dislike: Hayao Kakizaki. A big eater, he had to sortie after just one slice of steak. Stop Kakizaki, now on a rampage with his reason lost to hunger.

rows.notes: Open title; also quoted inside u0506.

rows.en: Battle Milia Fallyna and seize victory.
rows.notes: Pre-marriage form per brief.

rows.en: Milia Fallyna, the Zentradi ace pilot who had never known defeat. Her record and skill fully live up to the name "Milia the Ace," but she tasted defeat for the first time in a one-on-one duel with the human genius pilot Maximilian Jenius. Fight Milia, who after that duel went on to history's first interstellar marriage.
rows.notes: chikyujin rendered 'human'.
Open title; bujin = warrior.

rows.en:
Battle Vrlitwhai Kridanik
and seize victory. (No large units)

Unusually for a Zentradi, Vrlitwhai Kridanik, a Zentradi fleet commander, sees the bigger picture and chose the path of coexistence with humans. Fight Vrlitwhai, a mighty warrior strong enough to take on a Valkyrie in the flesh.

rows.notes: Open title; katakana 'peaky' (twitchy, hard-to-handle tuning) kept as English. Alternative: 'Wild Card Pilot'.

rows.en: Battle Isamu Alva Dyson and seize victory.
rows.notes: Japanese omits 'Alva'; glossary en used.

rows.en: Isamu Alva Dyson, a man who carries daring, recklessness and plain stupidity in the same pocket. Skilled enough to win the "Roy Focker Medal", an ace pilot's mark, three times, he lost it all three times for repeated breaches of regulations. Fight Isamu, the wild man.
rows.notes: Japanese omits 'Alva'; glossary en used.
Japanese omits 'Alva'; glossary en used.
Open title.

rows.en: Battle Guld Goa Bowman and seize victory.

Guld Goa Bowman puts his clear mind and refined piloting skills to use as chief developer and test pilot. Unlike a certain troublemaker, he is earnest and upright, with great strength of will, yet he also hides a fierce fighting instinct. Battle Guld, who has Zentradi blood in his veins.
rows.notes: 'A certain troublemaker' kept as vague as the Japanese (a dig at Isamu).
Open title; literally 'the captain who bears the name of genius'.

rows.en: With a genius touch, Maximilian Jenius commands the Macross 7 fleet and captains the space carrier Battle 7. Since taking command he has lived up to the name of genius, and his piloting skills are as sharp as ever. Battle Max: captain, commander and genius pilot!
rows.notes: Japanese uses the short form Max in the last sentence; kept. Reordered fleet/carrier so 'Battle 7' does not wrap across lines.

rows.en:
Battle Milia Fallyna Jenius and
seize victory.

Milia Fallyna Jenius, Mayor of City 7, boasts a 99% approval rating among its citizens. When City 7 is in danger, she shows the youthful spirit to sortie in a Valkyrie herself, mayor or not, and her skills as the ace Milia are as sharp as ever. Battle Milia, the fighting mayor!
Battle Ozma Lee and seize victory.

Ozma Lee, S.M.S. Skull Squadron leader, was once a New U.N. Forces ace with a wealth of combat experience. He's soft on his sister and a bit overprotective, but he's as strict a soldier as he ever was. Battle Ozma, a soldier to the core.
Battle Klan Klang and seize victory.

Klan Klang, Pixie Team leader, upholds her clan's traditions and pride with a noble spirit. She's a beauty in her prime, but clumsy genes somehow make her body a child's when micronized. Battle Klan, who is clumsy in love as well as in her genes.
Battle Brera Sterne and seize victory.

With no memory of his past, Brera Sterne lives day after day of battle as an empty combat machine. Most of his body has been made cyborg by implants, and now he exists only to carry out the missions he is ordered to. Battle Brera, the sorrowful combat machine.

Battle Golg Boddole Zer and seize victory.
(No large units)
rows.notes: Tag for large units being barred from sortie coined as '(Large units cannot sortie)'; align with u0509/u0553/u0608.

rows.en: Golg Boddole Zer, Supreme Commander of the Zentradi fleet, exists as a central bio-unit wired directly into the Boddole flagship. Battle Boddole Zer, a ruthless Zentradi who will not hesitate to kill even his own allies for the sake of his victory.
rows.notes: Japanese 'Boddol flagship' rendered 'the Boddole flagship'; no glossary entry.

rows.en: Battle the SDF-1 Macross and seize victory.
rows.notes: Full series title would overflow (394 px); used the glossary mecha name 'SDF-1 Macross'. Title row u0541 keeps the full name.

rows.en: The Super Dimension Fortress Macross was built by restoring a giant space battleship that fell from the sky. The Macross name, which ended the year-long interstellar war with the Zentradi, would be passed down for ages. Battle the Macross, where the whole story began.
rows.notes: Japanese says 'interstellar war' here (no 'First'), so not rendered as Space War I.
Ship target: 'Destroy', as other ship objectives (u0321 carrier).
Gavil-style 'beauty' title (glossary pattern '<X> Beauty'); kanji = duel + beauty. Mission is vs Glavil.

rows.en: Glavil is a giant, monster-like Protodeviln of tremendous combat power. Without Gavil's orders it has only the wits to keep destroying, yet it wields weapons stronger than the Macross Cannon. Battle Glavil, menace to humanity.
rows.notes: Glavil gender unknown in glossary; 'it' used, the Japanese calls Glavil a monster.

rows.en: Gepelnitchi is a Protodeviln with the intellect to devise the Spiritia Farm Project for the endless sharing of Spiritia, and the leadership to carry it out. Battle Gepelnitchi, who has the power to drain all the Spiritia in the galaxy.

Battle the Vajra Queen and seize victory.
(No large units)
rows.notes: Same sortie tag as u0539.

rows.en: The Vajra Queen controls the Vajra and gives them orders. With the fertility to keep bearing cocoons for the Vajra's prosperity and the power to unite the galaxy's will, the Queen is a dire threat. Battle the Vajra Queen to save the galaxy.
rows.notes: No pronoun for the Queen ('the Queen' repeated) to avoid assigning gender.

rows.en: Battle enemy battleships of all eras and seize victory.
rows.notes: Literally 'successive/historical enemy battleships'; 'of every era' would be 345 px, so 'of all eras'.

rows.en: The Zentradi are a race of giants over 10 m tall, and their battleships are even more gigantic than they are. And after Space War I, the enemies humanity met as it spread across space were all huge and mighty. Battle the giant battleships that appear one after another!
rows.notes: First Interstellar War rendered with glossary 'Space War I'.

rows.en: The ship brought a technological revolution through OverTechnology,
but it also pointed to an unknown threat from extraterrestrial life.
A.D. 2000. To counter the threat that was sure to come from space,
humanity founded the "U.N. Government," a body above all nations.
However, no small number of factions opposed it,
and they banded together as the Anti-U.N. Forces,
sparking the conflict that would later be called the "Unification Wars."
The long war finally ended in 2007. Meanwhile, the giant battleship
rows.notes: 'choukika' (long-drawn-out) folded into 'The long war'. No A.D.: the row does not start with seireki.

rows.en: was under constant repair, to be reborn as a U.N. Forces battleship.
After so many years of war, the threat from space that had started it all
was all but forgotten, but the fateful hour was drawing near...
A.D. 2040. In search of new places to live, humanity
had sent many large-scale colony fleets out into space.
Numerous planets had been discovered and developed into colony worlds,
and an age had come when many a generation called one of them home.
Drawn into the first interstellar war in history 30 years earlier,
humanity barely escaped extinction by wielding the power of "culture,"
made peace with the Zentradi, and founded the New U.N. Government.
But the end of the war did not simply mean the arrival of peace.
It began with postwar rebuilding, then quelling some Zentradi remnants,
and even to bolstering defenses against unknown threats yet to come.
The New U.N. Forces were still absolutely indispensable,
and the buildup of new fighting strength went on as well...
A.D. 2045. The 37th colony fleet, which had left Earth seven years earlier,
built around Macross 7, the seventh ship of the New Macross class,
carried over a million citizens through space in search of a new planet.
The fleet's commander, who was also captain of the space carrier Battle 7,
was Maximilian Jenius, the genius pilot of Space War I.
Meanwhile, Macross 7's residential City 7 was governed by Mayor Milia,
once feared even within the Zentradi forces as "Milia the Ace."
She was also Max's wife, wed in wartime in the first interstellar marriage.
Led by these two former aces, the Macross 7 fleet sailed on in peace,
but that a battle with the fearsome Varauta Army lay in wait for them
was something not a single person had foreseen...
A.D. 2059, 49 years after the end of humanity's first interstellar war.
The 25th giant colony fleet to set out, the "Macross Frontier,"
was sailing on toward the center of the galaxy.
The living areas inside the ship recreated the same environment as Earth's,
and over 10 million people went about their peaceful daily lives.
But at the end of that tranquil voyage,
a fierce battle against unknown space creatures lay in wait,
and almost none of the citizens had any idea...
With Boddole Zer defeated, the Boddole Zer Main Fleet had lost its core.
The Zentradi, who knew nothing but fighting under orders,
no longer had the strength to take on the Macross and Vrlitwhai's fleet.
The Zentradi forces, for all their overwhelming might,
had been defeated by the power of Lynn Minmay's song.
Thus Space War I ended, and the New U.N. Government was born.
A new foundation was laid for two races to walk the road ahead together.
Earth, all but destroyed, steadily made its way toward recovery.
Yet new problems were bound to arise sooner or later.
Overpopulation. Resource depletion. And contact with unknown threats.
To solve these problems not yet seen, humanity

Afterward, Basara kept on thriving as the vocalist of Fire Bomber,
and became a singer whose voice thundered across the galaxy.
But he himself had no interest whatsoever in such things,
and later set off to wander space alone, but that is another story.
though Battle 7 was heavily damaged in the fight with the Protodeviln,

the fighting, too, is likely not over yet...

A civilian pilot until he was caught up in a Zentradi attack and met Lynn Minmay; he became a military pilot to protect her. His indecision leaves his heart torn between two women. (CV: Kenji Nojima)
rows.notes: Hikaru. Read 'caught up in the attack' as applying to him (it also fits Minmay; both were caught up in the scene).

rows.en: A Unification Wars veteran, as tough with booze and women as in battle. Hikaru Ichijyo's senior, looked up to by him as a big brother. Leads Skull Squadron as its reliable ace. (CV: Akira Kamiya)
rows.notes: Roy Focker. 'Skull daitai' (battalion) rendered with glossary 'Skull Squadron'.

rows.en: A pilot who shone from his very first sortie. Nickname: Max. He defeated the enemy ace Milia, which later led to his marriage to the alien Milia. A truly exceptional man. (CV: Sho Hayami)
rows.notes: Maximilian Jenius.

rows.en: A former Zentradi pilot. She infiltrated the Macross to find the one who shot her down. She found Max and challenged him to a duel, but lost. He then proposed, and they married. (CV: Eri Takeda)
rows.notes: Milia (Micronian). 'proposed to' is passive in the source; the scene settles Max as the proposer.

rows.en: Hikaru's subordinate, a big carefree guy. Mouthing off in battle gets him in jams Hikaru or Max must save him from, but he's so sunny and easygoing he's hard to hate. Average skills. (CV: Katsumi Suzuki)
rows.notes: Kakizaki.

rows.en: The Macross's top idol. Her "Minmay Attack" caused a culture shock that ended the interstellar war. A legendary diva whose story is still told generations later.
rows.notes: Minmay. No CV in source.

rows.en: A Zentradi division commander. Belligerent and quick to fight, he leads from the front, obsessed with sinking the Macross. While many chose to live with Earth, he kept seeking battle. (CV: Kosuke Meguro)
rows.notes: Quamzin.

rows.en: A Zentradi pilot. Called "Milia the Ace," she was so skilled that even male Zentradi soldiers feared her. After losing to Max in battle, she marries him. (CV: Eri Takeda)
rows.notes: Milia. 'Ace no Milia' rendered 'Milia the Ace' (also an open mission title, keep in sync).

rows.en: Giants created by the ancient Protoculture through genetic engineering. Bred as soldiers, they had never known "Culture" and react excessively when they first encounter it.
rows.notes: Zentradi race entry.

rows.en: A Zentradi fleet commander and gifted strategist who cornered the Macross time and again. Touched by forbidden Culture fighting the Macross, he chose to live with Earthlings. (CV: Ryuzaburo Otomo)
rows.notes: Vrlitwhai. Source tense mixes present; past used for the first two facts.

rows.en: Supreme commander of the Zentradi fleet. The central bio-unit of the Boddole flagship, he grasps Culture, if only slightly. He is ruthless, willing to use any means to seize victory.
rows.notes: Golg Boddole Zer. 'Boddoru-kan' (his ship) rendered 'the Boddole flagship'; glossary has only 'Boddole Zer Main Fleet' / 'Boddole Zer's mobile fortress'.

rows.en: His outstanding flying skills won him the job of test pilot for a new prototype. He and Guld have been friends since high school, but they cut ties after a certain incident. (CV: Takumi Yamazaki)
rows.notes: Isamu.

rows.en: Developer and pilot of the YF-21, a brain wave-controlled prototype. After meeting Isamu again, he clashes with him over a woman and the race to build the next-gen fighter. (CV: Unsho Ishizuka)
rows.notes: Guld.

rows.en: A virtual idol who became the galaxy's No. 1 star within no time of her debut. With hypnotic songs she controls people and plunges Macross City into chaos.
rows.notes: Sharon Apple (female per glossary). No CV in source.

rows.en: My profile? You shouldn't go digging into people's pasts. Forget that and listen to my song! If you wanna know me, just listen to my songs. Now let's go! (CV: Nobutoshi Canna)
rows.notes: Basara, first person. CV: the actor's own romanisation is 'Canna' (Hepburn would give 'Kanna').

rows.en: Fire Bomber's new vocalist. Born to Max and Milia, she has flown Valkyries since she was little, so she's a fine pilot too. At an age where two men are on her mind. (CV: Tomo Sakurai)
rows.notes: Mylene.

rows.en: An elite pilot who joined the special assault unit Diamond Force young. He saw Basara, singing on the battlefield, as an enemy, but came to understand him in time. (CV: Takehito Koyasu)
rows.notes: Gamlin.

rows.en: Honored for his service in the war with the Zentradi, he became commander of the colony fleet Macross 7. Retired from active duty, he is still a genius pilot and flew a Valkyrie into battle. (CV: Sho Hayami)
rows.notes: Max (7). 'kantai shirei' = fleet commander.

rows.en: A former Zentradi ace pilot serving as mayor of City 7. Though mayor, she sorties when City 7 is attacked, and citizens back her as the fighting mayor. (CV: Eri Takeda)
rows.notes: Milia (7).

rows.en: A Varauta Army commander tasked with attacking the Macross 7 fleet and gathering Spiritia, he defied Gepelnitchi's orders to awaken one of his comrades, Sivil. (CV: Tomohiro Nishimura)
rows.notes: Gigile.

rows.en: He took over the Varauta Army from Gigile and tormented the Macross 7 fleet. He sums up whatever happens before him by calling it "beauty." He can merge with Glavil into an ultimate form. (CV: Akio Suyama)
rows.notes: Gavil. Matches glossary '<X> Beauty!' habit.

rows.en: Supreme commander of the Varauta Army. Powerful enough to drain all the Spiritia in the galaxy, he plans the Spiritia Farm Project to secure an endless supply of Spiritia.
rows.notes: Gepelnitchi. No CV in source.

rows.en: A high schooler in a pilot training course, he became a Valkyrie pilot after a Vajra attack. Born into an elite kabuki family, he once played female roles thanks to his gift and good looks. (CV: Yuichi Nakamura)
rows.notes: Alto. 'onnagata' rendered 'played female roles'.

rows.en: Alto's classmate. A gifted long-range sniper whose motto is "Enemy or woman, I always drop my target." He has known Klan for years. His older sister was a soldier and sniper too. (CV: Hiroshi Kamiya)
rows.notes: Michael (source says Mihaeru in the unlock row; here no name). 'otosu' = shoot down / win over; 'drop' keeps both.

rows.en: Alto's junior. An electronics whiz, he is also special advisor to the tech research division of megacorp LAI. In battle he flies the EW-equipped RVF-25, controlling drone fighters. (CV: Jun Fukuyama)
rows.notes: Luca. 'unmanned fighters' rendered 'drone fighters'.

rows.en: Skull Squadron leader at S.M.S., the private special military group Alto and co. belong to. A New U.N. Forces veteran, he took in Ranka for personal reasons and looks after her. (CV: Katsuyuki Konishi)
rows.notes: Ozma. 'toaru jijou' (certain circumstances) rendered 'personal reasons'.

rows.en: Leader of S.M.S.'s Pixie Team. She flies a crimson Queadluun-Rhea. In battle she is a giant Zentradi, but when micronized her body becomes that of a little girl. (CV: Megumi Toyoguchi)
rows.notes: Klan Klang (giant).

rows.en: Leader of S.M.S.'s Pixie Team. When micronized, a genetic anomaly makes her body childlike, and her personality too. Michel often mocks her, and they're always fighting. (CV: Megumi Toyoguchi)
rows.notes: Klan Klang (Micronian). Source says Mishel -> Michel.

rows.en: A New U.N. Forces pilot who lost his memory and became a combat machine. Nearly emotionless, he lived only to carry out missions, but contact with Ranka slowly changes him. (CV: Soichiro Hoshi)
rows.notes: Brera.

rows.en:
A rookie who has dreamed of being a pilot since childhood.
Honest and earnest; a little timid, but shows a bold side
once fired up. (CV: Jun Konno)

rows.en:
Raised wealthy, wanting for nothing, but bored of a thrill-free
life, so became a pilot. A veteran of many battlefields; foul-mouthed,
but adored as a good big brother. (CV: Tetsu Inada)

rows.en:
Born into a military family where service is mandatory, and a
rare female pilot even among them. Cheerful and friendly with
both men and women, which men often misread. (CV: Hinako Sasaki)
rows.notes: Player pilot profile (Female Pilot A slot). 'female pilot' is in the source; no pronouns added.

A female pilot of proven skill, rigorously trained from childhood
by a mercenary father. Raised by a single dad, perhaps, so rough
by nature, yet with a feminine side: likes cooking. (CV: Miho Hino)

Press the L and R buttons together

Press the □ button to attack the locked-on

Press the ○ button to attack the locked-on

On units with multiple special weapons,
hold the L button and press □
to switch special weapons.

Some special weapons are capable of
multi-lock-on, locking onto several
enemies at once!

For multi-lock-on, hold down
the ○ button to lock onto
multiple enemies within range.

Release the ○ button during multi-lock-on
to hit every enemy locked at that moment
with your special weapon!

These shooting attack controls
are the same in Fighter, Battroid
and GERWALK modes.
That covers the basics of shooting attacks.

Training is over when you reach

The number of combo hits

In Battroid mode, hold
the L button to guard.
Guarding reduces the damage you take.

While guarding, press
Up, Left or Right on the D-pad to move

Guarding also resets the camera angle

If you have a wingman,
combine the SELECT button and D-pad
